System

Soft targets, utility targeting, LOS and telegraphs

Soft targeting helps select an enemy or ally, but a selection does not guarantee a hit. Melee/projectile/area rules still use the server's current positions, collision, faction and ability definition.

Scope and player interaction

Soft targeting helps select an enemy or ally, but a selection does not guarantee a hit. Melee/projectile/area rules still use the server's current positions, collision, faction and ability definition.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase07committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

NoTarget → SoftTarget → GroundAim → UtilityAllyTarget → InvalidTarget → ConfirmedCast

WBP_TargetFrame observes results from URPGTargetingComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Targeting_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
TargetId: transient actor/network identity, resolved on server
TargetPointCm: finite world vector constrained to range and valid surface
TargetPolicy: Hostile|Friendly|Self|Ground; authored per ability
MaxRangeCm and RadiusCm: definition values, not UI inputs
RequiresLOS=true; trace channel and occlusion policy recorded per ability
TargetRevision/ActionSequenceId: reject stale actor reuse

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGTargetingComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_TargetFrameLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
SelectSoftTarget(Candidate) -> Selected|None; local-only hint
CycleTarget(Direction) -> Candidate; visible candidate set, controller-ready
ValidateTargetIntent(AbilityId, TargetIntent) -> ValidatedTarget|OutOfRange|NoLineOfSight|WrongFaction
ConfirmGroundTarget(Point) -> AbilityRequest; client intent, server rechecks

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Mouse/cycle input chooses a readable target or ground reticle, with name/health from public replicated state.
  2. When the player activates an ability, submit the intended actor/point and ability ID; do not send a claimed damage amount or hit result.
  3. Server verifies actor existence, alive state, hostile/friendly policy, distance from approved origin, LOS and point bounds.
  4. A cast may revalidate at impact/end according to its authored tracking policy; moving out of range during a cast is not automatically a guaranteed hit.
  5. For an area effect, server queries candidate actors, filters/deduplicates them and applies effect eligibility; reticle graphics have no damage authority.
  6. Replicate accepted telegraph center/radius/start/end and semantic shape ID so remote clients show the same warning even if their render frame differs.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Add URPGTargetingComponent to BP_PlayerCharacter and route mouse selection/IA_TargetNext through the local controller; keep authoritative validation callable from GAS.
  2. Author DA_Targeting_Default and an explicit targeting profile for each initial ability. Add a behind-wall dummy and friendly character fixture.
  3. Create WBP_TargetFrame and a ground-reticle visual with noncolliding components; bind to target lifetime and public health delegates.
  4. Set collision query channels to block intended world geometry and ignore cosmetic sprite layers. Display debug traces only in development.
  5. Reopen the ability definitions to assign target policy, range, LOS, retarget behavior and cancellation reason; do not infer these from weapon art.

Reopen Phase07 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / Dummy_Near / Dummy_BehindWall / Ally_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Target dies before server validation -> TargetDead; no cost under precommit-rejection policy.
Client changes radius/range in packet -> ignored/rejected; server definition wins.
Ground target inside inaccessible geometry -> InvalidTargetPoint; reticle becomes invalid before confirm where possible.
Target hidden by local canopy fade -> server wall LOS still determines eligibility.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed melee range 220 cm, ranged range 1800 cm and ground radius 250 cm for fixtures. No PvP targeting initially. Target assistance must not secretly extend server range.

Show a reason-specific reticle state, shape outline and countdown text; no color-only telegraphs. Log invalid vectors and excessive target requests with rate limits.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
